card.text: Saucer-shaped moon orbiting at the outer edge of Saturn's A ring.

introduction.text: Richard Terrile and the Voyager 1 team found Atlas in 1980. Cassini later spotted a faint, temporary ring along its orbit.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Photographs mapped onto the measured shape; shadows and unreliable samples are left out.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 15.1 km sphere from the Cassini shape; accuracy varies by region.
